# Coverer subdivision tie-breaking: several valid coverings exist, but the exact array must
# agree with BigQuery, including symmetric shapes and cells touching a boundary.

SELECT S2_COVERINGCELLIDS(ST_GEOGFROMTEXT('LINESTRING(0 0, 1 1)'), max_cells => 4)
=> [{"v":"384307168202282325"},{"v":"1152921504606846975"},{"v":"1153202979583557632"},{"v":"1921535841011411627"}]
